title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：plug　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 plug 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the engineer ① fitted the plug that no worker in the workshop would have recorded, and he said the fitting was the whole of the year. The ② plug, meaning the stopper itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a plug, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ plug in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ plug at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A plug, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the engineer said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the plug was the whole of the matter, meaning the connection and not the stopper. The ⑥ plug, meaning the connection and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; plug, he said, is either something you fit or the only word that means both a stopper and a connection. He said the connection is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ plug had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ plug of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of recording; plug, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ plug I remember is the stopper recorded in the manual, which closed in 1969 and is still recorded as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ plug, my mother said in 1971, is the only stopper that improves by being recorded; every plug, she said, is a connection that has agreed to look like a stopper. She said the connection was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 插头；塞子（指车间里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 插头；塞子（指那个插头本身，与短短的拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：fit the plug 插上这一个插头
D. n. 插头；塞子（指留给孩子们装的那一件）
E. n. 插头之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的插头之事）
F. n. 插头；塞子（指说明书里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 插头、接通（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 接通（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: fitted the plug that no worker in the workshop would have recorded
The plug, meaning the stopper itself and not the lever
the plug at the far bench
the plug was the whole of the matter
the plug had become a line in a manual
The plug of the whole thing
A plug, my mother said in 1971

answers.why: fit the plug 意为“插上这一个插头”，1962 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯记载的一个插头做了一遍。
plug 意为“插头；塞子”，指那个插头本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
plug 意为“插头；塞子”，指车间里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
plug 意为“插头；塞子”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
plug 意为“插头、接通”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个接通就是那件事的全部。
plug 意为“接通”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个插头，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
plug 意为“插头；塞子”，指说明书里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1967 年这一个成了说明书里的一行。
plug 意为“插头之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的插头之事是一处车间和三个年头的记载。
plug 意为“插头；塞子”，我记得的是说明书里记载过的那一个，1969 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一个。
plug 为抽象总称，母亲 1971 年说，插头是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的插头。
